filled.rearm_pose_dist: = value in configs/level1_realtime.json on disk (not read while pose_change_rules is false)
filled.pose_over_jitter_ratio: = value in configs/level1_realtime.json on disk (not read by the segmenter)
filled.rearm_mode: = 'motion_pose' (the label decoder did not exist at this commit)
filled.cls_window_ms: = value in configs/level1_realtime.json on disk (not read while rearm_mode is 'motion_pose')
filled.cls_conf: = value in configs/level1_realtime.json on disk (not read while rearm_mode is 'motion_pose')
filled.cls_stable_ms: = value in configs/level1_realtime.json on disk (not read while rearm_mode is 'motion_pose')

definitions.clips: every hauuto row of the manifest (training data of the deployed checkpoint), none excluded; clips with fewer hand frames than the checkpoint min_detected_frames are kept and flagged (the segmenter cannot emit for them)
definitions.run: one fresh Level1SignSegmenter per clip, every frame pushed with ts = i * 1000 / fps of the manifest, flush 1 ms after the last frame (as AC-S18 and G6 of scripts/level1_rearm_check.py); headless, deterministic
definitions.n_segments: number of SignSegment events of the clip
definitions.window_agrees: exactly one SignSegment AND its Level1Classifier.classify prediction == the prediction for the whole clip (the input of the model at training time); no prediction is never an agreement
definitions.rates: single_segment / n and window_agrees / n per group; None when n == 0
